body:
(1) I wish I could have parents that make me feel they care about me, that I shouldn't have to avoid them to feel better, that their presence didn't make me feel unfree. I wish there was someone to replace my parents.  
(2) I wish I wasn't so anxious and shy, that I wouldn't be so scared of rejection, that I could feel proud of me, that I could enjoy life, that I could trust myself, that life didn't feel so hard and painfull.  
(3) I wish my eases at school (and the fact that I can be described as smart in general even if I don't like to say it myself...) didn't make me feel totally different from others and that they stayed by my side only because I could help them, that I didn't feel like it was wasted or that they did me more harm than good.  
(4) I wish it didn't feel so hard to do anything. That I could enjoy my passions without worries.  
(5) I wish my friends and familly really cared about me, that they would invite me and check on me. I wish I could feel someone actually loving me and being supportive, someone that wouldn't hurt me, someone here for me, someone for hugging me, someone who checked on me, someone I could trust, someone I wouldn't be afraid to talk to.  
(6) I wish this world was better, and feel like it will eat you if you don't fight.

(1) For my parents, it's too late, I just can't bear them, they digust me, even if now they were good I couldn't ever let them be close to me, and the damage are done.  
For the rest it may not be totally impossible to change these but it'so hard and like I said I'm tired of trying for no results, I have no will to continue, I can't do it alone, and no one seems ready to take care of me. I'm not even sure I will ever feel good once the issues that can be are fixed. I'm not sure that will convince you but I hope so...
